data.name: Avelin's Journey
data.detailed_description:
We’re still early in development and actively shaping the game. What you see here is just the beginning, things may change, improve, or even be replaced.

Step onto a mysterious alien planet filled with ancient structures, floating ruins, and magical forces beyond understanding. In this strange world, towering pathways stretch endlessly toward the sky and the only direction forward is up.

In Avelin’s Journey, you will navigate a challenging vertical parkour where precision, creativity, and skill are the key to progress. Use a variety of tools and mechanics to overcome obstacles, cross impossible gaps, and climb ever higher through a surreal landscape of forgotten architecture and strange environments.

Every section of the climb presents new challenges. Some require careful timing, others demand clever use of your abilities. Falling might cost you progress, but each attempt makes you better, faster, and more determined to reach the top.

Unlike pure rage games, success in Avelin’s Journey comes from mastering the mechanics and learning how to use your tools efficiently. Improve your movement, refine your strategy, and find the best route upward.

How quickly can you complete the journey?

Features

  • Vertical Parkour Gameplay
    Climb higher and higher through a massive obstacle course that stretches into the sky.

  • Skill-Based Movement
    Master unique mechanics and tools to overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

  • A Mysterious Alien World
    Explore surreal landscapes, floating structures, and magical environments.

  • Challenge Yourself
    Improve your skills, reduce your mistakes, and try to reach the top faster with every run.

  • A Journey Upwards
    Every fall is a lesson. Every climb brings you closer to the summit.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
